subject: Mutual action playlist + governance roster for Helios Health launch cadence
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action playlist + governance roster for Helios Health launch cadence

Samira —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Per our discussion, I pulled together a concise mutual action "playlist" that focuses on governance and the 8-week launch cadence we talked through. The goal is to make responsibilities explicit, highlight a small set of high-risk dependencies, and leave room for weekly cadence checks so we can de-risk early.

Attached: Helios-MAP-v1.xlsx (master Milestone > Owner > Due date sheet) and a draft SOW we can iterate on.

Top-level summary:
- Week 0 (procurement & legal): finalize SOW + PO — Owner: Helios Procurement
- Weeks 1–2 (network & security): VPC peering and IP allowlist validation — Owner: Helios infra / Redwood infra engineering
- Weeks 3–4 (integration): API keys, sample data, golden prompts & evals — Owner: Helios devs / Redwood solutions
- Weeks 5–7 (pilot & metrics): run pilot, collect latency/cost, refine batching + quant profiles — Owner: Helios product / Redwood CS
- Week 8 (go/no-go): final validation and rollout plan — Joint owners

Known risks we need to track:
1) Firewall rules / IP ranges (blocker until week 2)
2) Data retention and audit log config (requires compliance sign-off)
3) SOW redlines around liability & data handling (legal needs to close)

Next actions (this week):
- Samira: confirm procurement timeline and PO owner (reply by Wed EOD)
- Monica: share the Redwood networking checklist and IP ranges (done — see attachment)
- Marissa: schedule weekly 30-min standups starting Jul 26 (can be recurring)

If that looks good I will send an updated MAP with explicit task owners and dates for each milestone.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0198

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple quick notes from procurement and infra:
- Procurement: we have a weekly purchasing sync on Thu; I will escalate the SOW to the PO owner (Raj Patel) and aim to have a signed PO by Jul 30.
- Infra: my network lead (attached) needs exact egress IP ranges; if Redwood can confirm a CIDR/IP list today that will speed up our firewall change window.

I attached an internal timeline that shows our preferred pilot window (Aug 9–Aug 23). If Redwood can commit to pilot SLIs and a light-weight rollback plan, we should be ok.

I'll confirm Raj's email by EOD so legal/procurement get looped.

Best,
Samira
